UtilizationRow.description:
One ranked interface by directional p95 utilization (DASH-003).

sessionCookie.description: Set by POST /api/v1/auth/login over HTTPS (vakr_session over loopback HTTP). State-changing requests also need the X-CSRF-Token header.
sessionCookie.name: __Host-vakr_session

info.description: JSON API of vakr, the network performance and reachability monitor. Browsers authenticate with the session cookie from `POST /api/v1/auth/login` and send `X-CSRF-Token` (from `GET /api/v1/auth/session`) on every state-changing request. Kiosk displays send `Authorization: Bearer vkk_...` (operator, read-only). On the monitoring node, the Unix socket `/run/vakr/api.sock` authorizes by the connecting account (root and vakr-admin: admin; vakr-view and vakr: operator). Errors use one envelope: `code`, `message`, `request_id`, `fields`. Lists page with `limit` and `cursor` and answer `page.next_cursor`. Times are UTC ISO 8601 with `Z`; a missing value is `null`, never 0.
info.title: vakr API
